title: Two things you've been dreaming of
note: I've watched you look at these for months. Every time you carry one and wear the other, I want you to remember how loved you are.

items.title: Your Coach bag
items.note: The one you kept going back to. It's finally yours — carry it everywhere, and think of me.

items.title: A ring, for my forever
items.note: A little circle with no end — just like my love for you.
